summary: In-line monitoring of sucrose concentration (5–15 % w/w, ±0.3 % w/w) in a clear, colourless aqueous solution flowing in a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20–30 °C and normal pressure; analyser 10 m away in a dry, safe room; daily hot caustic CIP; 1 reading per minute; laboratory refractometer as reference; customer asks for a proposed method and probe for a first trial.

facts_stated.text: Product is a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution.
Goal: in-line monitoring of sucrose concentration.

facts_stated.enquiry_quote: flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe
Our laboratory refractometer is the reference method

facts_stated.text: Analyser location: dry, safe room 10 m from pipe.

cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day
A reading every minute is enough
